en: Hmm, I see. I'm Mary.
I'm so graceful that
note: #7681 <pause> #7682 share one line (msg 300086). 'graceful' and 'Lady' in single quotes match #7779/#7780 (slice 097). Ironic.

en: everyone calls me
'Lady.' Bye-bye, mister.
Oh, you! We met the other day, didn't we?
You're no student, so what are you here for?
So this big building is the school?
Yep, a school without a shred of fun in it.
If Papa weren't a scholar, I'd never show up
every day at such a boring place.
Ugh, this talk's no fun anymore. Bye.
Wanna meet Papa sometime? He's a weirdo.
Back again, mister? Planning to enroll?
It's a top school, they say, but it's the worst.
It's all study, research, study, research here.
, do you like it here?
Or maybe...
Is it Lady Mary you want?
Isn't that 'Lady' meant ironically?
Someone certainly picked a fitting nickname.
Yes, someone gave it to me, the problem kid,
the tomboy who skips class and picks fights.
But I kind of like it.
Believe it or not, I've got it pretty rough.
I'm a scientist's kid, so everyone expects
me to be good at studying, naturally.
Even though I don't get science at all.
Hi there, mister.
You've got a sharp tongue, but you're nice.
Maybe I'll let you take me on a date. Hee hee.
Do you know someone at this school?
You come here practically every day.
I kind of look forward to your visits, mister.
Coming! Who is it?
My father Felix is in his laboratory, but...
You're not from the institute, are you?
Who are you, mister? A pushy peddler?
How rude. I'm no suspicious character.
is my name, I'll have you know.
I'm just not used to London yet.
Oh, really.
You can peddle without knowing the streets.
I make a point of doubting strangers.
Well, if you've no business here, goodbye.
I'm closing the door, so step back.
Honestly, what a girl.
...You're a pushy peddler, aren't you, mister?
Oh, you're back?
Father's busy wrestling with his research.
And I've got no time to chat.
I've got homework. Sorry.
If you want to see me, come to the school.
Bye.
Ugh, stop bothering me!
Or are you gonna do my homework for me?
! Welcome.
I'm pretty free right now. Wanna talk?
You don't see me as "Felix's kid,"
do you? That's a relief.
I'm just me. I'm Mary.
Come again,
I want to talk with you more.
Sorry for calling you "mister" at first.
I want to be a real lady someday.

variants.en: I want to be a real lady someday.

note: Variant for msg 301356 ends with a space: #7813 (slice 097) follows on the same line with no pause.

en: Owww... I bumped my head
Hey, what are you spacing out for?!
I'm sorry, miss.
But running around the pavement that fast
is a nuisance to everyone.
Handsome face, but you sure love to lecture.
How rude, talking that way to Lady Mary!
See ya! Watch where you're going, lover boy!
What a lively girl
If you're asking me on a date,
wait till school's over!
Oh, good morning,
This is the real me. Hee hee, bye!
Nah, can't be. Walks are for daytime, right?
Oh, hey, hey! You there, mister! Handsome!
Do me a favor, would you? Please!
